name: Δημοτικές Ενότητες Ελλάδας (1034)
title: Δημοτικές Ενότητες Ελλάδας (1034)
description: Δημοτικές Ενότητες (Municipal Units) of Greece per the Kallikratis administrative reform (Law 3852/2010). Municipal Units are the tier between Municipalities (Δήμοι) and Communities (Κοινότητες) — each represents a former pre-Kallikratis municipality merged into a modern Δήμος. Each record carries the unit's id and Greek name, an is_hq flag (whether it serves as municipal seat), full parent hierarchy (municipality / regional unit / region), and counts of child Communities split into Δημοτικές Κοινότητες (urban) vs Τοπικές Κοινότητες (rural). All Greek names preserved verbatim.
